source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice MCQs written from Chapter 1 (PDF 4-21), not printed in the book; same questions, order and keys as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Measurements) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. In mein definitions, SI units aur prefixes, scientific notation, ahmiyat wale hindse (significant figures) aur rounding, precision aur accuracy, uncertainty aur dimensions waise hi poochhe gaye hain jaise chapter sikhata hai. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The independent physical quantities in terms of which other physical quantities are defined are called:
(Woh azad (independent) physical quantities jin ki madad se baqi quantities define hoti hain, kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Base quantities kisi aur quantity se define nahi hotin; baqi quantities in hi se define hoti hain (1.1). Derived quantities base quantities par munhasir hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: The base quantities are the independent physical quantities in terms of which the other physical quantities can be defined.

blocks.prompt:
2 Which of the following is a derived quantity?
(In mein se derived quantity kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acceleration base quantities (length aur time) par munhasir hai, is liye derived hai (1.1). Length, mass aur time kitab ki mashhoor base quantities hain.

book_ref.quote: Derived quantities are those which depend on base quantities. Examples of derived quantities are velocity, acceleration, force, etc.

blocks.prompt:
3 Which group contains only base quantities?
(Kis group mein sirf base quantities hain?)
blocks.explanation: Length, mass aur time aam base quantities hain (1.1). Velocity, force aur density derived quantities hain.

blocks.prompt:
4 The measurement of a base quantity involves the choice of a standard and:
(Base quantity ki measurement mein standard chunne ke ilawa doosra qadam kya hai?)

options.text: quantity ko standard se mawazna (compare) karne ka tareeqa

blocks.explanation: Do qadam yeh hain: standard chunna, aur quantity ko standard se compare karne ka tareeqa taa ke aik number aur aik unit mil jaye (1.1).

blocks.prompt:
5 The measure of a physical quantity is expressed as:
(Kisi physical quantity ki peemaish kis tarah likhi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Quantity ko standard se compare karne se us ki peemaish aik number aur aik unit ki shakal mein milti hai (1.1).

blocks.prompt:
6 Physics is an experimental science, so the scientific method stresses the need for:
(Physics tajrubati (experimental) science hai, is liye scientific method kis cheez par zor deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.1: scientific method naapi ja sakne wali physical quantities ki durust measurement par zor deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7 According to the "Think over!" box, computer chips are made from silicon, which is obtained from:
("Think over!" box ke mutabiq computer chips silicon se bante hain; silicon kis se hasil hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Box kehta hai ke chips silicon se bante hain jo ret se milta hai; us se ret ka qila bhi ban sakta hai aur computer bhi (1.1).

blocks.prompt:
8 The whole world has become a global village mainly because of:
(Saari dunya global village (aalmi gaon) kis wajah se ban gayi hai?)

options.text: tez raftar zaraye ablagh (fast means of communication)

blocks.explanation: Information technology aur tez zaraye ablagh ne logon ko itna qareeb kar diya hai ke dunya global village ban gayi hai (1.1).

blocks.prompt:
9 Which of the following is an interdisciplinary area of Physics?
(In mein se Physics ka interdisciplinary (doosre ilm ke saath mila hua) shoba kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab Biophysics ko interdisciplinary areas mein likhti hai (1.1). Optics, Mechanics aur Superconductivity Physics ke areas mein likhe hain.

blocks.prompt:
10 The System International (SI) was established by an international committee in:
(System International (SI) aik international committee ne kis saal banaya?)
blocks.explanation: 1960 mein aik international committee ne definitions aur standards par ittefaq kiya; yahi system SI kehlata hai (1.2). 1995 woh saal hai jab plane aur solid angle derived units mein shamil hue.

blocks.prompt:
11 How many base units are there in SI?
(SI mein kitne base units hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.1 mein saat base units hain: metre, kilogram, second, ampere, kelvin, candela aur mole (1.2).

blocks.prompt:
12 The SI unit of intensity of light is:
(Roshni ki shiddat (intensity of light) ka SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.1: intensity of light ka unit candela (cd) hai. Mole amount of substance ka, kelvin temperature ka aur ampere electric current ka unit hai.

blocks.prompt:
13 The symbol of the SI unit of amount of substance is:
(Amount of substance (maadde ki miqdaar) ke SI unit ki symbol kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.1: amount of substance ka unit mole hai, symbol mol. M to prefix mega ki symbol hai.

blocks.prompt:
14 The SI unit of thermodynamic temperature is:
(Thermodynamic temperature ka SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.1: thermodynamic temperature base quantity hai aur us ka unit kelvin (K) hai.

blocks.prompt:
15 The units of plane angle and solid angle have been included in the list of derived units since:
(Plane angle aur solid angle ke units kab se derived units ki list mein shamil hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2 (derived units): plane angle aur solid angle ke units 1995 se derived units ki list mein shamil hain.

blocks.prompt:
16 The SI unit of solid angle is:
(Solid angle (thos zaviya) ka SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.2: solid angle ka unit steradian (sr) hai; radian (rad) plane angle ka unit hai.

blocks.prompt:
17 The pascal, expressed in base units, is:
(Pascal ko base units mein kaise likhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.2: Pa = N m⁻² = kg m s⁻² × m⁻² = kg m⁻¹ s⁻². (kg m s⁻² newton, kg m² s⁻² joule aur kg m² s⁻³ watt hai.)

blocks.prompt:
18 One coulomb is equal to:
(Aik coulomb kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.2: electric charge ka unit coulomb hai, C = A s.

blocks.prompt:
19 Which of the following is a derived unit?
(In mein se derived unit kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Newton (N = kg m s⁻²) base units par munhasir hai, is liye derived hai (Table 1.2). Ampere, kelvin aur candela base units hain (Table 1.1).

blocks.prompt:
20 Which of the following is a non-metric scientific unit that SI permits to be used?
(SI kis non-metric scientific unit ke istemal ki ijazat deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: SI do non-metric scientific units ki ijazat deta hai: atomic mass unit aur electron volt (eV) (1.2). Erg, dyne aur gauss purane CGS units hain jin ki SI ijazat nahi deta.

blocks.prompt:
21 The bar, used as the millibar in meteorology, is a unit of:
(Bar, jo meteorology (mausamiyat) mein millibar ki shakal mein istemal hota hai, kis cheez ka unit hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2: bar pressure ka unit hai; meteorology mein millibar aur engineering mein kilobar istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
22 The prefix pico stands for:
(Prefix pico kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.3: pico (p) = 10⁻¹². Nano 10⁻⁹, femto 10⁻¹⁵ aur tera 10¹² hai.

blocks.prompt:
23 The prefix exa stands for:
(Prefix exa kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.3: exa (E) = 10¹⁸. Peta 10¹⁵, tera 10¹² aur atto 10⁻¹⁸ hai.

blocks.prompt:
24 The symbol of the prefix for 10⁶ is:
(10⁶ wale prefix ki symbol kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.3: 10⁶ mega hai, symbol M (capital). m milli (10⁻³), µ micro (10⁻⁶) aur G giga (10⁹) hai.

blocks.prompt:
25 Most SI prefixes indicate order of magnitude in steps of:
(Zyada tar SI prefixes order of magnitude ko kitne kitne qadmon (steps) mein barhate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2: zyada tar prefixes 1000 ke steps mein badalte hain (milli, micro, nano, kilo, mega ...).

blocks.prompt:
26 Which prefix is NOT one of the four prefixes kept in SI from usage established before SI?
(Kaun sa prefix un chaar prefixes mein se NAHI jo SI se pehle ke istemal ki wajah se rakhe gaye?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar purane prefixes centi (10⁻²), deci (10⁻¹), deka (10¹) aur hecto (10²) hain (1.2). Kilo (10³) aam 1000 wale steps mein aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
27 1 cm² is equal to:
(1 cm² kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Power poore multiple par lagti hai (1.2): 1 cm² = (10⁻² m)² = 10⁻⁴ m². 10⁻² m² likhna prefix ka square bhool jana hai.

blocks.prompt:
28 Compound prefixes are not allowed in SI. The quantity 1 mµs should be written as:
(SI mein compound (dohre) prefixes ki ijazat nahi. 1 mµs ko kaise likhna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: mµ = 10⁻³ × 10⁻⁶ = 10⁻⁹ = nano, is liye 1 mµs = 1 ns (1.2), jaise kitab 1 µµF ko 1 pF likhti hai.

blocks.prompt:
29 Which of the following is written correctly according to the SI conventions?
(SI ke qaaidon (conventions) ke mutabiq kaun sa sahi likha gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Symbols chhote huroof (lower case) mein hain (kilo ke liye k), un ki jama (plural) nahi banti, aur number aur symbol ke darmiyan space hota hai (1.2).

blocks.prompt:
30 The correct symbol for the second is:
(Second ki sahi symbol kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har SI unit ki symbol hoti hai, abbreviation (mukhtasar lafz) nahi: "s", "sec" nahi (1.2). Symbols ki plural nahi banti.

blocks.prompt:
31 Which unit symbol begins with a capital letter because the unit is named after a scientist?
(Kis unit ki symbol capital letter se shuru hoti hai kyun ke unit kisi scientist ke naam par hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scientists ke naam wale units ki symbols ka pehla harf capital hota hai, maslan N (newton), Pa (pascal), W (watt) (1.2).

blocks.prompt:
32 Which unit symbol is a capital letter even though the unit is not named after a scientist?
(Kaun si symbol capital hai halaan ke unit kisi scientist ke naam par nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Symbols lower case mein hoti hain, magar litre ke liye "L" exception (istisna) hai (1.2). N, W aur Pa scientists ke naam ki wajah se capital hain.

blocks.prompt:
33 The full name of which unit begins with a capital letter?
(Kis unit ka poora naam capital letter se shuru hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Unit ka poora naam capital letter se shuru nahi hota (newton, metre), siwaye Celsius ke (1.2).

blocks.prompt:
34 The SI way of writing the unit of speed is:
(SI ke mutabiq speed ka unit kaise likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: SI mein solidus (m/s) ki jagah negative index (m s⁻¹) likha jata hai, aur symbols aur naam mila kar nahi likhe jate (1.2).

blocks.prompt:
35 According to the SI conventions, the millisecond is written as:
(SI ke qaaidon ke mutabiq millisecond kaise likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prefix unit se pehle aur baghair space ke likha jata hai: "ms", "m s" nahi (1.2). "m s" ka matlab metre second ho jayega.

blocks.prompt:
36 Practical measurements with a screw gauge should be recorded in:
(Screw gauge ki practical measurements kis unit mein likhni chahiyen?)
blocks.explanation: Practical kaam instrument ke liye sab se aasan unit mein likha jata hai; screw gauge ki readings mm mein, magar aakhri nateeja munasib base units mein (1.2).

blocks.prompt:
37 In scientific notation, 0.000507 is written as:
(Scientific notation mein 0.000507 kaise likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scientific notation mein decimal ke baayein sirf aik non-zero hindsa hota hai (1.2): 0.000507 = 5.07 × 10⁻⁴.

blocks.prompt:
38 In scientific notation, 63 400 is written as:
(Scientific notation mein 63 400 kaise likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Decimal ke baayein aik non-zero hindsa: 63 400 = 6.34 × 10⁴ (1.2). 63.4 × 10³ ki value wahi hai magar yeh standard form nahi.

blocks.prompt:
39 Using E = mc² with c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, the energy equivalent of 2 kg of mass is:
(E = mc² aur c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ le kar 2 kg mass ke barabar energy kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: E = mc² = 2 kg × (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)² = 2 × 9 × 10¹⁶ J = 1.8 × 10¹⁷ J. "Do You Know?" box 1 kg ke liye 9 × 10¹⁶ J deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
40 According to the table of time intervals, the period of visible light waves is about:
(Time intervals ke table ke mutabiq nazar aane wali roshni (visible light) ki lehron ka period taqreeban kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: "For Your Information" table visible light ke liye 2 × 10⁻¹⁵ s deta hai; 10⁻³ s sunai dene wali awaz, 10⁻⁶ s radio waves aur 10⁻¹³ s solid mein atom ki vibration hai.

blocks.prompt:
41 According to the table of time intervals, which of the following is the shortest?
(Time intervals ke table ke mutabiq in mein se sab se chhota waqfa kaun sa hai?)

options.text: Solid mein atom ki vibration ka period
Sunai dene wali awaz ki lehron ka period
Dil ki do aam dharkanon ka darmiyani waqt

blocks.explanation: Table se: solid mein atom 1 × 10⁻¹³ s, radio waves 1 × 10⁻⁶ s, awaz 1 × 10⁻³ s, dil ki dharkan 8 × 10⁻¹ s.

blocks.prompt:
42 Which of the following can be found exactly, without any uncertainty?
(In mein se kya bilkul theek, baghair kisi uncertainty ke, maloom kiya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke pages bilkul theek gine ja sakte hain, magar lambai naapne ke liye instrument chahiye, aur har naapi gayi quantity mein kuch uncertainty hoti hai (1.3).

blocks.prompt:
43 The maximum uncertainty in a reading, estimated as one smallest division of the instrument, is called:
(Instrument ke aik sab se chhote division ke barabar maani gayi zyada se zyada uncertainty kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3: instrument ke aik sab se chhote division jitni zyada se zyada uncertainty absolute uncertainty kehlati hai.

blocks.prompt:
44 The absolute uncertainty of a metre rule graduated in millimetres is:
(Millimetre ke nishanon wale metre rule ki absolute uncertainty kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Absolute uncertainty aik sab se chhota division hai; millimetre wale metre rule par yeh aik millimetre hai (1.3).

blocks.prompt:
45 One edge of a rod is at the 12.0 cm mark of a metre rule and the other at the 37.5 cm mark, each reading uncertain by ±0.05 cm. The length of the rod is:
(Rod ka aik sira metre rule ke 12.0 cm aur doosra 37.5 cm ke nishan par hai; har reading mein ±0.05 cm uncertainty hai. Rod ki lambai kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: (37.5 ± 0.05) cm - (12.0 ± 0.05) cm = (25.5 ± 0.1) cm; dono ±0.05 cm mil kar 0.1 cm bante hain, jo least count hai (1.3).

blocks.prompt:
46 A length is recorded as (18.6 ± 0.1) cm. Its true value lies between:
(Aik lambai (18.6 ± 0.1) cm likhi gayi. Us ki asal (true) value kin do values ke darmiyan hai?)
blocks.explanation: 18.6 - 0.1 = 18.5 cm aur 18.6 + 0.1 = 18.7 cm, jaise kitab ki (23.5 ± 0.1) cm 23.4 cm aur 23.6 cm ke darmiyan hai (1.3).

blocks.prompt:
47 Fractional uncertainty is the ratio of:
(Fractional uncertainty kis cheez ki nisbat (ratio) hai?)

options.text: absolute uncertainty aur measured value ki
measured value aur absolute uncertainty ki
least count aur percentage uncertainty ki
measured value aur least count ki

blocks.explanation: Section 1.3: fractional uncertainty = absolute uncertainty / measured value; 100 se zarb dene par percentage uncertainty milti hai.

blocks.prompt:
48 A length of 40.0 cm is measured with an absolute uncertainty of 0.1 cm. The percentage uncertainty is:
(40.0 cm lambai 0.1 cm absolute uncertainty ke saath naapi gayi. Percentage uncertainty kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Percentage uncertainty = (0.1 cm / 40.0 cm) × 100 = 0.25% (1.3). 0.0025 fractional uncertainty hai, percentage nahi.

blocks.prompt:
49 A length of 20.0 cm is measured with an absolute uncertainty of 0.1 cm. Its fractional uncertainty is:
(20.0 cm lambai 0.1 cm absolute uncertainty ke saath naapi gayi. Fractional uncertainty kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fractional uncertainty = 0.1 cm / 20.0 cm = 0.005 (1.3). Is ka koi unit nahi.

blocks.prompt:
50 On a digital instrument, if the last digit of the display fluctuates by 1 or 2, you should:
(Digital instrument ke display ka aakhri hindsa 1 ya 2 tak oopar neeche ho raha ho to kya karna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3 (digital instruments): agar aakhri hindsa 1 ya 2 tak badle to woh aakhri hindsa likh lein.

blocks.prompt:
51 If the last digit of a digital balance fluctuates by much more than 2, it may mean that:
(Digital balance ka aakhri hindsa 2 se kaafi zyada badal raha ho to is ka kya matlab ho sakta hai?)

options.text: balance tawaqqo se zyada precise hai
reading par koi cheez, maslan hawa ke jhonke (air currents), asar daal rahi hai

blocks.explanation: Zyada fluctuation ka matlab ho sakta hai ke reading par hawa ke jhonke jaisi koi cheez asar daal rahi hai, aur dikhaya gaya hindsa asal mein significant nahi (1.3).

blocks.prompt:
52 When a measurement is recorded with correct significant figures, its last digit:
(Jab measurement sahi significant figures ke saath likhi jaye to us ka aakhri hindsa:)

options.text: andaza (estimate) hota hai jo value ki accuracy batata hai

blocks.explanation: Aakhri hindsa andaza hota hai aur likhi gayi value ki accuracy ki nishani hai (1.3).

blocks.prompt:
53 The same object weighs 3.145 g on an electronic balance and 3.1 g on a lever balance. The reading 3.145 g:
(Aik hi cheez electronic balance par 3.145 g aur lever balance par 3.1 g aayi. Reading 3.145 g ke bare mein kya sahi hai?)

options.text: is mein kam significant figures hain
zyada accurate hai, jo behtar instrument dikhati hai

blocks.explanation: Scientists foran samajh jate hain ke 3.145 g, 3.1 g se zyada accurate hai, jo behtar ya zyada precise instrument dikhata hai (1.4). Is ki uncertainty ±0.001 g hai.

blocks.prompt:
54 When the uncertainty is dropped from a quoted number, it is understood that the number has an uncertainty of at least:
(Jab likhe gaye number se uncertainty hata di jaye to samjha jata hai ke us mein kam az kam kitni uncertainty hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.4: aam taur par uncertainty nahi likhi jati, aur samjha jata hai ke number ke aakhri hindse mein kam az kam 1 unit ki uncertainty hai.

blocks.prompt:
55 It is better to quote a result in scientific notation because it:
(Nateeja scientific notation mein likhna behtar kyun hai?)

options.text: significant figures ki tadaad mein shak (ambiguity) khatam karta hai
nateeje ko zyada accurate bana deta hai

blocks.explanation: Section 1.4: scientific notation mein likhne se significant figures ki tadaad ke bare mein koi shak nahi rehta.

blocks.prompt:
56 As we improve the quality of our measuring instruments and techniques, the result can be quoted to:
(Jab hum apne instruments aur tareeqe behtar karte hain to nateeja kis tarah likha ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.4: instruments aur tareeqe behtar hon to nateeja zyada se zyada significant figures tak likha jata hai aur accuracy barhti hai.

blocks.prompt:
57 The number of significant figures in 0.00804 is:
(0.00804 mein kitne significant figures hain?)
blocks.explanation: Significant figures ke baayein zeros significant nahi; 8 aur 4 ke darmiyan wala zero significant hai (1.4). Is liye 8, 0, 4: teen.

blocks.prompt:
58 The number of significant figures in 0.05050 m is:
(0.05050 m mein kitne significant figures hain?)
blocks.explanation: Shuru ke zeros significant nahi; dono 5 ke darmiyan wala zero aur decimal fraction ka aakhri zero significant hain (1.4): 5, 0, 5, 0 = chaar.

blocks.prompt:
59 The number of significant figures in 3.0700 is:
(3.0700 mein kitne significant figures hain?)
blocks.explanation: Significant figures ke darmiyan zero significant hai, aur decimal fraction mein significant figure ke daayein zeros bhi significant hain (1.4): 3, 0, 7, 0, 0 = paanch.

blocks.prompt:
60 The number of significant figures in 9.050 × 10⁻³ kg is:
(9.050 × 10⁻³ kg mein kitne significant figures hain?)
blocks.explanation: Scientific notation mein ten ki power ke ilawa saare hindse significant hain (1.4): 9, 0, 5, 0 = chaar.

blocks.prompt:
61 Which of the following has exactly three significant figures?
(In mein se kis mein theek teen significant figures hain?)
blocks.explanation: 0.0303 mein 3, 0, 3 (shuru ke zeros significant nahi): teen (1.4). 0.0030 mein do, 3.003 mein chaar aur 30.30 mein chaar hain.

blocks.prompt:
62 A mass of 5000 kg is measured on a scale of least count 100 kg. In scientific notation it is recorded as:
(5000 kg mass 100 kg least count wale scale se naapi gayi. Scientific notation mein kaise likhi jayegi?)
blocks.explanation: Integers mein significant zeros ki tadaad least count par munhasir hai (1.4). 100 kg least count par sau (hundreds) wala hindsa aakhri significant hai: 5.0 × 10³ kg (do significant figures).

blocks.prompt:
63 Rounded off to three significant figures, 12.48 becomes:
(12.48 ko teen significant figures tak round off karein to kya banega?)
blocks.explanation: Chhora jane wala pehla hindsa 8 hai, jo 5 se zyada hai, is liye rakha jane wala hindsa 4 aik barh jata hai (1.4): 12.5.

blocks.prompt:
64 Rounded off to three significant figures, 3.6247 becomes:
(3.6247 ko teen significant figures tak round off karein to kya banega?)
blocks.explanation: Chhora jane wala pehla hindsa 4 hai, jo 5 se kam hai, is liye aakhri rakha gaya hindsa nahi badalta (1.4): 3.62.

blocks.prompt:
65 Using the book's rounding rules, 5.8350 rounded off to three significant figures is:
(Kitab ke rounding ke qaaidon se 5.8350 ko teen significant figures tak round karein to kya banega?)
blocks.explanation: Hindse aik aik kar ke hatayein: 5.8350 → 5.835. Hataya jane wala hindsa 5 hai aur pichla hindsa 3 taaq (odd) hai, is liye aik barh jata hai (1.4): 5.84.

blocks.prompt:
66 Using the book's rounding rules, 9.2650 rounded off to three significant figures is:
(Kitab ke rounding ke qaaidon se 9.2650 ko teen significant figures tak round karein to kya banega?)
blocks.explanation: 9.2650 → 9.265; hataya jane wala hindsa 5 hai aur pichla hindsa 6 juft (even) hai, is liye waisa hi rehta hai (1.4): 9.26 (jaise kitab mein 73.650 → 73.6).

blocks.prompt:
67 If the digit to be dropped is 5, the previous digit to be retained is increased by one when it is:
(Agar hataya jane wala hindsa 5 ho to pichla rakha jane wala hindsa kab aik barhaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rounding ka qaaida (iii) (1.4): agar hataya jane wala hindsa 5 ho to pichla hindsa taaq ho to aik barhta hai, juft ho to waisa hi rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
68 The length, breadth and thickness of a sheet are 3.04 m, 1.50 m and 0.84 cm. Its volume to the appropriate significant figures is:
(Aik sheet ki lambai, chaurai aur motai 3.04 m, 1.50 m aur 0.84 cm hai. Munasib significant figures ke saath us ka volume kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: V = 3.04 m × 1.50 m × 0.84 × 10⁻² m = 3.8304 × 10⁻² m³. 0.84 cm mein sirf do significant figures hain, is liye V = 3.8 × 10⁻² m³ (1.4, Example 1.1 ki tarah).

blocks.prompt:
69 A box of mass 4.36 kg (lever balance) has two coins of masses 12.04 g and 15.07 g (beam balance) added to it. The total mass to the appropriate precision is:
(4.36 kg (lever balance) ke dabbe mein 12.04 g aur 15.07 g (beam balance) ke do sikke daale gaye. Munasib precision ke saath kul mass kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 4.36 kg + 0.01204 kg + 0.01507 kg = 4.38711 kg. Sab se kam precise mass 4.36 kg mein do decimal places hain, is liye kul mass 4.39 kg (1.4, Example 1.2 ki tarah).

blocks.prompt:
70 The sum 63.2 m + 4.51 m + 0.006 m to the appropriate precision is:
(63.2 m + 4.51 m + 0.006 m ka majmua munasib precision ke saath kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Majmua 67.716 m hai. 63.2 m mein sab se kam decimal places (aik) hain, is liye jawab 67.7 m (1.4).

blocks.prompt:
71 The answer of 7.68 kg - 3.2 kg to the appropriate number of significant figures is:
(7.68 kg - 3.2 kg ka jawab munasib significant figures ke saath kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 7.68 - 3.2 = 4.48 kg. Tafreeq mein jawab sab se kam decimal places rakhta hai; 3.2 kg mein aik hai, is liye 4.5 kg (1.4).

blocks.prompt:
72 The sum 1503 kg + 24.06 kg + 37.2 kg to the appropriate number of significant figures is:
(1503 kg + 24.06 kg + 37.2 kg ka majmua munasib significant figures ke saath kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Majmua 1564.26 kg hai. 1503 kg mein koi decimal place nahi, is liye jawab ikaai (units) tak: 1564 kg (1.4).

blocks.prompt:
73 The answer of 3.25 × 10³ m × 1.6 m / 2.40 m to the appropriate number of significant figures is:
(3.25 × 10³ m × 1.6 m / 2.40 m ka jawab munasib significant figures ke saath kya hai?)
